cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Say You’re Sorry
cards.instruction: Maneuver someone into apologizing without naming the offense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Your parents arrive in ten minutes. I'd like to be able to smile at you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought we'd sorted this out by text.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. You sent a thumbs-up. I couldn't hear any remorse.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're right here. Could you give the sad face a sentence beginning with 'I'?
